candidates.title: How to do a Low to High Cable Wood Chopper
candidates.description: To perform a low to high cable woodchopper, set the pulley to the lowest position and attach a single handle. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, sideways to the machine, and grasp the handle with both hands near your outside knee. Engage your core and rotate your torso as you pull the handle diagonally upward across your body to above your opposite shoulder, simulating a chopping motion. Keep your arms extended but not locked, and pivot your back foot to allow a full range of motion. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides to ensure balanced training.
